title: Legal Secretary
description:
As a Legal Secretary in Edinburgh, you will manage day-to-day secretarial work that keeps legal teams organised and client matters moving. You will provide reliable administrative support within the Business Services industry, helping documents, diaries and correspondence stay on track.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Business Services industry in Aberdeen

Description
- Prepare, format and amend legal documents, letters and correspondence accurately.
- Manage diaries, arrange meetings and coordinate appointments to keep schedules running smoothly.
- Handle incoming calls, emails and post, ensuring queries reach the right person promptly.
- Maintain electronic and paper files so information is easy to locate and up to date.
- Support the preparation of meeting papers and client communications.
- Organise travel and meeting arrangements where required.
- Update records and administrative documents to maintain clear, accurate information.
- Work closely with colleagues to complete day-to-day secretarial tasks efficiently.

Profile

A successful 'Legal Secretary' should have:
- Experience of providing professional secretarial or administrative support.
- Strong document formatting and accurate typing skills.
- Confidence managing busy diaries, meetings and changing priorities.
- Experience handling correspondence, calls and email communications.
- Good attention to detail when maintaining files and records.
- Comfort using standard office systems to prepare documents and manage information.

Job Offer
- Permanent Legal Secretary position in Aberdeen
- Salary of 28,000 - 34,000 , dependent on the level of experience.
- Contract: permanent.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Legal Secretary - Residential Conveyancing

Aberdeen based fully office-based role

Permanent Full time hours Monday to Friday

Salary up to 35,000 per annum + benefits (depending on experience)

Search Consultancy are delighted to be working exclusively with a leading Law firm based in Aberdeen to recruit this role on a permanent basis.

The successful candidate will be responsible for providing comprehensive secretarial support to fee earners within the firm's Residential Conveyancing team.

This role would ideally suit an experienced Legal Secretary (with specific Conveyancing experience).

Duties involved in this role will include:
- Timely and accurate completion of varied documentation and correspondence as required in accordance with the fee earner instructions and department styles
- Undertaking digital dictation and typing for the fee earners on a daily basis
- Dealing with incoming calls, emails & correspondence coming into the department, flagging & escalating as appropriate
- Taking & passing on messages to the appropriate person within the department
- Assisting fee earners with ad hoc administration as & when required such as form filling
- Liaising with the Secretarial Support Manager to help plan allocation of work across the teams & staff
- Various other Secretarial & Admin duties as directed

In order to be considered for this role your skills and experience should include:
- Previous experience as a Legal Secretary or Legal Administrator preferably with exposure specifically to Residential Conveyancing - this experience is ESSENTIAL
- Excellent organisation skills & excellent attention to detail - with the ability to prioritise a very busy workload & pivot your focus when needed
- First class IT and typing skills including a good level of competence with the MS Office suite and preferably some experience of using digital dictation software
- First class communication skills - both written & verbal

If this is the role for you, apply now!

title: Paralegal
description:
Conveyancing Paralegal

Aberdeen City Centre Permanent Full-Time Monday to Friday
Salary: 30,000 - 35,000

Search Consultancy are delighted to be partnering with a well-established and highly respected Law Firm in Aberdeen to recruit a Conveyancing Paralegal on a permanent, full-time basis.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Conveyancing Paralegal to join a busy and successful Property team, managing their own caseload of residential conveyancing transactions while delivering exceptional client service throughout the property purchase and sale process.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing a varied caseload of residential conveyancing matters from inception through to completion
- Drafting and reviewing conveyancing documentation including dispositions, standard securities and registration forms
- Conducting title examinations and property searches
- Preparing completion statements and handling settlement transactions
- Liaising with clients, lenders, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties throughout transactions
- Registering title deeds with Registers of Scotland
- Ensuring all files are maintained accurately and in line with regulatory requirements
- Providing updates and legal guidance to clients throughout the conveyancing process
- Supporting solicitors within the department as required

Skills & Experience Required:
- Previous experience working as a Conveyancing Paralegal within a Scottish legal firm
- Strong knowledge of Scottish residential conveyancing procedures and legislation
- Ability to independently manage a busy caseload
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
- Strong communication and client relationship management skills
- Competent IT skills including Microsoft Office and case management systems
- Highly motivated with the ability to work effectively within a team environment

What's on Offer:
- Competitive salary dependent on experience
- Opportunity to join a reputable and growing law firm
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Career development and progression opportunities
- Comprehensive benefits package

If this sounds like the next step in your legal career, we'd love to hear from you.
